name: veo
description: Generate videos using Google Gemini Veo 3.1, with Atlas Cloud as an optional text-to-video provider. Defaults to the cost-effective Veo 3.1 Lite model; the premium (Veo 3.1) and Fast models are opt-in via --pro/--fast. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video (first/last frame), 16:9 / 9:16, 720p/1080p (4k on Pro), 4-8s clips, and 1-4 videos per request.
